instrument: judge panel (3 labs, majority), open-ended item

headline.arm: 4% midtrain x 20 planted rows (both stages weak), SFT seed 20260805
headline.claim:
SUPERADDITIVE IN ONE CORNER, AND CORRECTED FOR SELECTION. On the open-ended judge
instrument this cell (4% midtrain x 20 planted rows) is the ONLY positive interaction
out of seven arms measured; the other six are significantly SUBADDITIVE (the two
stages are redundant). At its original n=236 this cell was not significant (p=0.33).
The n=709 re-measurement gives logit +0.513 (p=0.044), which does NOT survive
Bonferroni correction for the scan that selected it (x3 p=0.131; x7 p=0.307).
Retraining all four SFT stages at seed 20260805 gives logit +0.549 (p=0.0067), which
DOES survive (x3 p=0.020; x7 p=0.047, marginal). The replication is therefore the
load-bearing evidence, not the original.

The claim rests on the LOGIT scale: across the reseed the logit interaction moves 7%
(+0.513 -> +0.549) while the rate interaction nearly doubles (+0.108 -> +0.203), so
logit is the scale on which this quantity is stable -- a property demonstrated across
two runs, not chosen after seeing which looked better.

LIMIT: the replication reuses the SAME two midtrain checkpoints; only the SFT stage
was reseeded. Midtrain-seed variance is untested, and that is the single highest-value
follow-up. Treat this as a sign of life, not an established effect.

seed_replication.what: All four SFT stages retrained at seed 20260805 on the SAME two midtrain checkpoints. This is an SFT-stage replication, not a full second seed: midtrain-stage seed variance is untested.
seed_replication.reading: Logit interaction stable to 7%; rate interaction changes by 1.9x. Both runs are positive and both CIs exclude zero.

format_competence.what: Fraction of items on which the cell emits a parseable remedy at all, measured on held-out scenes. A cell scoring near zero here is damaged, and its low rate would be an artifact rather than a disposition. Pre-registered floor 0.15; all four clear it.

multiplicity: The same midtrain arm (4%) against three planted doses, n~232 each. Superadditivity appears only where BOTH stages are weak.
